spec.title: Flow: fast Rust compiler — portable working rules

p.PORTABLE-RUST-WORKFLOW: These rules supersede older shared-target advice. Keep project build configuration usable on stable Rust on Linux, macOS and Windows. Installing this flow installs instructions only, never machine software or settings.

facts.COMPILE-CHECK: Use `cargo check -p <crate>` for compile checks; build only when an actual artifact is required.
facts.TARGETED-TESTS: Use `cargo nextest run -p <crate> <filter>` if installed; otherwise use `cargo test -p <crate>` with the affected target/filter. Check a meaningful nonzero case count. Run the entire required test set only at the task's completion gate, retaining the designated final campaign gate.
facts.AFFECTED-CLIPPY: Run `cargo clippy -p <crate>` only for affected crates.
facts.NO-IMPLICIT-EXPENSIVE-COMMANDS: Do not run `--release`, `cargo clean` or `cargo update` without an explicit owner request. Initial installation of an explicitly requested external compiler tool is a separate setup operation, not permission to release-build the project.
facts.WAIT-FOR-LOCK: On “Blocking waiting for file lock”, wait; do not kill processes or remove lock files.
facts.PRIVATE-TARGET: Every worktree has its own `target/`. Never share `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` between worktrees or link to another worktree's target. Preserve source and foreign targets.
facts.PRIMARY-CHECKOUT: Discover the primary checkout from the first `worktree` record of `git worktree list --porcelain`. An explicitly owner-selected local warm-cache source may override it only after verifying that both belong to the same Git common directory. Do not infer the source from cwd or branch name.
facts.WARM-CACHE-OPTIONAL: Warm target copying is optional. On Windows skip it. On Unix attempt `cp -a --reflink=always` into a unique temporary directory inside the new worktree; publish as target only on complete success. If unsupported or failed, discard only this attempt's temporary copy and build normally. Never fall back to a full ordinary copy. Preserve mtime and never overwrite an existing target.
facts.SAFE-REMOVAL: Remove the exact worktree with `git worktree remove <path>` only after preserving unique work and evidence and proving no live writer remains. Its private target is removed with it.

p.PACKAGE-CONTRACT: The setup/removal authority and ownership contract is @spec://org.vibevm.world/fast-rust-compiler/flows/fast-rust-compiler/FAST-RUST-COMPILER#root. Linux-only setup instructions do not apply to other hosts.
